rows.text: Ministry of Home Affairs notification No. 10/1/99-M&G(i) of 26 October 1999: the President has been pleased to appoint Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee to be the Prime Minister with effect from 1030 hours of 13 October 1999; the members of the Council of Ministers are appointed, on his advice, from the same time.

locator.item: Notification No. 10/1/99-M&G (i), New Delhi, the 26th October, 1999 (Hindi on page 1, English on page 3)

rows.text: Notification No. 10/1/99-M&G(ii) of 26 October 1999: the President has been pleased to accept the resignation of Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee of his office of Prime Minister, and of the listed members of the Council of Ministers, with effect from 13 October 1999.

locator.item: Notification No. 10/1/99-M&G (ii), New Delhi, the 26th October, 1999

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-11 only. The President's appointment, the oath or swearing-in, stated effective dates, confidence motions and votes, resignation announcements, letters and acceptances, requests to continue in office and attestations during a continuation stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Deputy prime ministers, ministers, the President and party offices are excluded.
